Method of Attack: Kernel driver vulnerability allowing denial of service, privilege escalation, and disabling security solutions
Exploitation of vulnerable driver code copied from WinRing0.sys to read/write kernel memory, PCI configurations, IO ports, and Model-Specific Registers (MSRs)
Privilege escalation to SYSTEM level allowing attackers to disable security products, overwrite system components with malicious payloads, and corrupt the operating system
Impacted Systems: Any Windows 10 computer with OMEN Gaming Hub software installed
Attack Vector: Locally available vulnerable kernel driver used by OMEN Gaming Hub software
Pre-installed software on HP OMEN devices
Downloadable from Microsoft Store for Windows 10 PCs with OMEN peripherals
